notes: The web adapter refuses MCX, CDS and BCD (EXCHANGE_NOT_SUPPORTED, groww_adapter.py:385-390) although its capability registry lists them; Groww publishes NSE and BSE cash, F&O and indices only; the desktop refuses them with the same words (unsupported_exchanges).
Indices have no book: a Depth subscribe on an index takes the price subject on both sides (index_depth_falls_back_to_price).

Order updates come from Groww's order subjects on its NATS server, on a connection of their own with a socket token of their own (web GrowwOrderUpdateAdapter, openalgo#2474; desktop brokers/groww/order_feed.rs): equity and F&O only, Groww has no commodity order subject. Each push is completed from GET /v1/order/detail (symbol, prices, side, type, product) on both sides (order_stream_lifecycle), from the push alone when that read fails (order_detail_read_fails); a reconnect starts with a new token and reader (order_stream_reconnects).
